## Hi! Welcome to my website!

My name is Karolina Sienko and I’m currently a master's student in the Environmental Data Science Program at the Bren School of Environmental Science & Management at UC Santa Barbara.

I have a background in physics and mathematics, and now I'm exploring how I can apply my quantitative and coding skills to environmental questions. I'm excited to use data to better understand environmental systems and the challenges facing our planet. 

This site is where I share my coursework, projects, and things I've been working on as I learn more about environmental data science!
